entities.summary: Amir-Abbas Hoveyda was an Iranian economist and politician who served as Prime Minister of Iran from 27 January 1965 to 7 August 1977. He was the longest-serving prime minister in Iran's history, serving in office for over 12 years. He also served as the first Secretary-General of the Rastakhiz Party from 1975 to 1976 and the deputy prime minister and minister of finance in the cabinet of his predecessor, Hassan Ali Mansur.
